description.zh:
数据集ID，
点击工作台-->数据集，打开选定的数据集后，url中携带有该数据集的cubeId信息

多表场景下，该参数须为空。
description.en:
The ID of the dataset. To obtain the ID, navigate to \*\*Workbench\*\* > \*\*Dataset\*\* in the Quick BI console. Open the dataset and find the \`cubeId\` in the URL.

In multi-table scenarios, this parameter must be empty.

description.zh:
多数据集id列表
模型会根据问题内容，选择列表中一张或多张表生成回答，多表场景下该参数为必要，单表场景不需要该参数。
description.en: A list of dataset IDs. The model selects one or more tables from the list to generate an answer based on the question. This parameter is required for multi-table scenarios and is not used for single-table scenarios.

description.zh:
用户ID。
><notice>该字段不填写时默认以组织所有者身份查询数据。></notice>
description.en:
The ID of the user.
><notice>If you do not specify this parameter, data is queried as the organization owner by default.></notice>

descriptions.zh: 特别说明：当使用者被授权调用该API时，默认使用者有权限通过传入userId以该用户身份查询对应的数据
descriptions.en: Note: Authorized users can query data as another user by passing the userId of the target user.
